name: aronda Access Tool
author: arondadigital

sections.description:
The aronda access tool extends WordPress websites with a user-friendly accessibility and assistance tool. Visitors to your website can adjust font sizes, increase contrast, have text read aloud, or customize the appearance of the page to suit their individual needs.
The tool is automatically displayed on the website and allows users to improve readability and usability within seconds – without changing the existing web design.
The focus is on making websites more accessible for people with visual impairments, reading difficulties, or limited usability.

Key Features

  • Adjust font size
    Font size can be increased using a slider, making text easier to read.

  • Adjust line spacing
    Line spacing can be increased or decreased to improve readability.

  • Adjust word spacing
    The spacing between words can be changed, which is especially helpful for people with reading difficulties.

  • Enable simple font
    Website fonts can be switched to easy-to-read, sans-serif fonts.

  • Increase contrast
    If contrast is too low, text and background colors are automatically adjusted to improve readability.

  • Highlight links
    All clickable elements and links are highlighted so they are easier to recognize.

  • Enlarge mouse cursor
    The mouse cursor can be enlarged to make website navigation easier.

  • Increase color saturation
    Colors, images and videos can be displayed with increased saturation.

  • Text-to-speech
    Website text can be read aloud so content can also be consumed audibly.

Use Cases

The aronda access tool is particularly suitable for:

  • Company websites
  • Government and public institutions
  • Schools and educational institutions
  • Online shops
  • Service provider websites
  • Tourism websites
  • Information websites
  • Associations and organizations

In short: For all websites that should become more accessible and user-friendly.

Integration in WordPress & compatible with the Elementor Website Builder

After installation, the aronda access tool automatically appears as an icon on the website and can be opened by visitors. The settings directly affect the display of the website without changing content or layout.
The plugin was also developed for the Elementor website builder and is therefore compatible with all important functions of the aronda access tool.

Free Version Features

The free version already includes:

  • Adjust font size
  • Adjust line spacing
  • Adjust word spacing
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP version 7.4 or higher
  • MySQL version 5.0 or higher
  • Elementor installed and activated

Recommended Requirements

  • PHP version 8.1 or higher
  • MySQL version 5.6 or higher
  • WordPress memory limit of at least 64 MB (128 MB or higher recommended)
  • Latest version of Elementor

Installation via WordPress

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for aronda access tool.
  3. Install the plugin.
  4. Activate the plugin.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP file.
  4. Install and activate the plugin.

After activation, the aronda access tool is automatically displayed on the website, usually as an icon in the bottom right corner of the page.
Optional settings can be adjusted in the WordPress backend under aronda access tool.
The plugin generally works with all WordPress themes.
Depending on the structure of the website, there may be differences in some functions.
sections.faq:
What does the aronda access tool do?

The aronda access tool is an accessibility tool for WordPress websites that allows visitors to adjust the appearance of the website to their personal needs, such as font size, contrast or readability.

Who is this tool for?

The tool is intended for people with visual impairments, reading difficulties, color vision deficiencies or limited usability, as well as generally for all users who prefer a more readable website.

Will my website design be changed?

No. The tool only changes the display for the individual visitor. The actual design and layout of the website remain unchanged.

Do I need to rebuild my website to use the tool?

No. After installation, the tool is automatically displayed on the website and works immediately.

Can users reset the settings?

Yes. All settings can be reset individually or completely.

Can text be read aloud?

Yes. Users can click on text areas and have the content read aloud.

Does the tool work on all devices?

Yes. The aronda access tool works on desktop, tablet and smartphone.

Is the tool suitable for accessibility?

Yes. The tool helps make websites more accessible and easier to read, especially for people with visual impairments or reading difficulties.

Does the tool work perfectly on every website?

We cannot guarantee that the tool will work perfectly on every website.
Especially functions such as the screen reader or text-to-speech feature depend heavily on the structure of the website. This means the website should be cleanly built, structured and properly coded so that all functions can work optimally.
The tool can improve accessibility, but it cannot make a technically poorly structured website fully accessible.
